0022600130.text: The San Antonio Spurs (1-2, 0-2 at home, 10th in the West) host the Sacramento Kings (0-3, on a three-game losing streak, 15th in the West) in the Spurs' fourth game of the season. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The Spurs won their last meeting 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17, 2026, and swept the 2025-26 season series 3-0, with no games yet in the 2026-27 series.
